column1: XCL XP AND ACHIEVEMENTS
399 achievements across 15 categories, worth 1,239,360 XP in total.
ONE XP TOTAL ACROSS EVERY TITLE
A driver has one XP total and one rank, whatever they race. ACC on console, ACC on PC, Le Mans Ultimate and iRacing all feed the same number.
The game column says what an achievement counts. all means progress in every title adds up, so a win in LMU counts the same as a win in ACC.
A specific title means it only counts progress in that title. The Nordschleife family is ACC only because the circuit is not in the other games.
Rank 150 is defined by the title agnostic achievements alone. A driver who only races ACC can still reach it.
Title specific achievements are a head start on the climb from 150 to 250, never a gate on reaching 150.
THE THREE NUMBERS
XCL-R is skill. It goes up and down with race results and says how fast you are.
SR is behaviour. It goes up and down with clean driving and gates which races you can enter.
XP is time served. It only ever goes up and says how much you have done, not how good you are.
Keep that distinction visible everywhere, or XP will be mistaken for a skill measure and devalue XCL-R.
THE CURVE
Rank 1 to 250. Rank 1 to 2 costs 100 XP, rank 249 to 250 costs 23,650.
Every title agnostic achievement adds up to exactly rank 150.
Ranks 150 to 250 need 1.9 million XP. Title specific achievements cover 168,000 of it and racing covers the rest, roughly 1,150 races.
That split is deliberate. If XP came only from achievements, the fastest members would finish the system and XP would die for them.
THE FIRST SESSION
A driver who completes one clean race and fills in their profile earns about 1,125 XP and lands at rank 5.
Five rank ups in one sitting is the hook. The curve is built so this happens by design, not by accident.
WHAT TO CHECK BEFORE BUILDING
Every metric column must map to something the site can already count, or the achievement cannot be awarded.
Metrics marked referrals, months_member, supporter_months, coaching_sessions and merch depend on systems that are not built yet.
There is no VIP subscription yet, so no achievement references one. Add it to the catalogue when the tier exists.
Safety rating achievements start at 4.50 because every new driver begins at 4.00.
Decide whether historical races count. Awarding 298 achievements retroactively to 11,000 members in one night is a large job and a loud one.
TUNING
Change any XP value in the Achievements sheet and the curve no longer lands on rank 150. Recalculate when you do.
Prefer adding achievements over inflating existing ones. More small wins beats fewer big ones.
ADDING A TITLE
A new title needs its own short ladder in the Per Title category and nothing else. The title agnostic catalogue already covers it.
Adding title specific achievements does not move rank 150, because the curve is fitted to the title agnostic pool only.
